role.title: Intake Officer
permissions: Prepare human assessment requests as local drafts

recipients.title: SYN Bank A / designated human review team
SYN Telco B / designated human intake team

recipientResponsibilities.HANDOVER-BANK: Human verification and assessment of reported unfamiliar debits, credential exposure and transaction information; the prototype only prepares a local draft.
recipientResponsibilities.HANDOVER-TELCO: Human assessment of whether the reported SMS concern falls within the mobile provider remit; do not assume the provider sent the SMS or that SIM swapping occurred. Local draft only; sharing permission unverified.

value: Prepare human assessment requests as local drafts

requiredContext: F06 abnormal debit refers specifically to TX-01
guidelines.step: Prepare a local internal human assessment record.
limits: Approved synthetic prototype guidance only; no authority for real-world action.
E09 conflicts, reported completed and payment requested are outside this teaching entry.
The human specialist decides further assessment; no freeze, refund or recovery promised.
guidelines.onMismatch: Omit this step and preserve missing or conflicting facts for human review.
guidelines.humanEscalation: A designated bank human specialist decides further assessment; the intake role performs no account or transaction action.

requiredContext: S4 explicitly identifies SYN Telco B as the person's mobile service provider
Configuration includes corresponding human intake responsibilities
guidelines.step: Prepare a local SYN Telco B human intake draft.
limits: Approved synthetic prototype guidance only; no authority for real-world action.
Also requires S4 to explicitly identify SYN Telco B as the person's mobile provider and configured human intake responsibilities; this limited draft is not a runtime matcher.
Unknown sharing permission permits local drafting only; no sharing or verification asserted.
Do not infer SIM swapping or change a mobile service.
guidelines.onMismatch: Omit this step and preserve missing or conflicting facts for human review.
guidelines.humanEscalation: The receiving human intake team verifies whether the concern falls within its remit; sharing permission remains unverified.

requiredContext: Existing corresponding SMS clues have source references
guidelines.step: Optionally prepare a separate summary of existing SMS clues for human assessment.
limits: Approved synthetic prototype guidance only; no authority for real-world action.
Also requires existing SMS clues and source references; this limited draft is not a runtime matcher.
The employee may decline duplicate preparation; rejection retains facts and gaps.
Do not request new materials or claim the SMS is verified.
guidelines.onMismatch: Omit this step and preserve missing or conflicting facts for human review.
guidelines.humanEscalation: Human staff decide whether a separate existing-clue summary is useful; no new materials are required.
